facts.title: useLayouts | Free animated React components
facts.description: Free React components with animation, built with Framer Motion and Tailwind CSS. Preview them, copy the code, and add them to your site.

research.name: useLayouts
research.note: Free animated React components built on Motion and Tailwind, many shaped like physical objects such as folders, books and polaroids.

effects: Confidential Folder card that slides out of a folder

unverified: The component source is public in the MIT repository iurvish/uselayouts (linked from the site); that repository has not yet been researched as its own candidate.
Only Confidential Folder and Polaroid Stack were seen rendered; the other effects are taken from the component menu.
